gloss: to meet face-to-face; to confront; to come face-to-face with

definitions.gloss: to meet face-to-face; to meet in person
definitions.explanation: To meet someone directly, in person rather than remotely. Often implies a significant or awaited meeting.

definitions.gloss: to confront; to come face-to-face with
definitions.explanation: To face something directly, including difficult situations, challenges, or uncomfortable realities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{対面|たいめん}した。
examples.english: We met face-to-face for the first time in a while.

examples.japanese: ⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧⟦{対面|たいめん}→対面：10377_taimen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}したい→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to talk in person, not online.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{対面|たいめん}した⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧、⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The moment I met the baby for the first time, tears came to my eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{対面|たいめん}する。
⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{対面|たいめん}して⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めない→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: I won't give up even when confronted with difficulties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧きた⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{対面|たいめん}する{時|とき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The time has come to confront the problem I've been avoiding for years.

notes:
Has become especially common since the COVID-19 pandemic, where ⟦{対面|たいめん}→対面：10377_taimen⟧ (in-person) is contrasted with ⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧ (online) or ⟦リモート→リモート：04743_rimooto⟧ (remote) in work and education contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{対面|たいめん}{授業|じゅぎょう}→対面授業：17035_taimenjugyou⟧: in-person classes
- ⟦{対面|たいめん}→対面：10377_taimen⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: face-to-face sales
- ⟦{対面|たいめん}→対面：10377_taimen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧: to meet in person
- ⟦{対面|たいめん}→対面：10377_taimen⟧{式|しき}: face-to-face format

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{面会|めんかい}→面会：15925_menkai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to visit/meet — used for visiting someone in hospital, prison, etc.
- ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧: to meet directly — more casual alternative
- ⟦{対峙|たいじ}→対峙：12357_taiji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to confront/stand against — stronger, implies opposition or standoff
